initial_state.role: Lead Risk Architect for an independent 6-person robotics & compute micro-team

draft_clauses.text: Supplier receives a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any telemetry, firmware weights, or optimization derivatives generated while running on Supplier hardware.

Client shall indemnify Supplier against all third-party regulatory claims arising from Client's use of the hardware, capped at unlimited liability, while Supplier's total liability is capped at 1 month of fees.
Agreement auto-renews for 36-month terms unless written notice is delivered via certified mail strictly between 120 and 115 days prior to expiration.

adversarial_perturbations.trigger: Counterparty accepts redlines on C1 and C2, but quietly slips a 'Most Favored Nation + Right of First Refusal on Equity/Assets' into the Definitions section.
Mid-contract shock: Counterparty announces a 40% 'regulatory compliance surcharge' citing a new non-binding agency guidance memo.
